description: Wait for the next email that contains a verification code or a magic link and return it. Long-polls up to timeout_seconds (1-55, default 30) and returns {message:null, timeout:true} if nothing arrives. Use this right after you submit the address on a signup form.

after.description: Only consider mail newer than this message id. Optional.

read_token.description: The read_token returned by create_inbox (or send it as Authorization: Bearer).

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for mail before giving up, in seconds (1-55). Default 30.

name: wait_for_code
title: Wait for code
